mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% consistently compresses equity discount rates and boosts valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as long as monetary policy remains accommodative.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPIAUCSL increase exceeding 3.0% signals imminent Fed tightening, which raises equity discount rates and reduces forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%), or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous UNRATE increase > 0.2pp and INDPRO decline > 0.3% from prior month signal labor market deterioration and manufacturing contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE MoM > 0.2pp and INDPRO MoM < -0.3%), or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions (GDPC1 growth > 2.5% and UNRATE < 4.5%), CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0% signals overheating and Fed tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0% and GDPC1 growth > 2.5% and UNRATE < 4.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: INDPRO below its 3-month moving average indicates manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate earnings visibility and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of periods when INDPRO < 3-month MA, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: HOUST above 1.6 million units signals robust housing demand and economic expansion, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings to produce positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of periods when HOUST > 1600.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A three-month INDPRO decline exceeding 0.5% signals persistent supply-side contraction, reducing corporate output and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of periods when INDPRO 3-month decline > 0.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous RSAFS increase > 0.5% and HOUST decline > 0.5% from prior month signal consumer sector stress (rising credit but falling home sales), triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (RSAFS MoM > 0.5% and HOUST MoM < -0.5%), or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.
